test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In December 2021, Supreme Court stated that the Law Commission can consider the issue for appointment of Dowry Prohibition Officer, equivalent to Right to Information Officer. Who were the justices to give this order ?

options.text: Justice Indira Banerjee and Hemant Gupta
Justice Uday Umesh Lali and AM Khanwilkar
Justice DY Chandrachud and AS Bopanna
Justice L Nageswara Rao and Sanjay Kishan Kaul

solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice DY Chandrachud and AS Bopanna.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the given statement, the Supreme Court has allowed the** Law Commission** to consider the appointment of a **Dowry Prohibition Officer,** equivalent to a** Right to Information Officer.** 
 
• **Justice Indira Banerjee** and **Hemant Gupta **were the judges who gave this order.
 
• Justice Hemant Gupta and Justice Indira Banerjee, two members of the previous Constitution Bench, have **retired now.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dowry** is a practice in India where the groom's family demands money or gifts from the bride's family as a condition of marriage.
 
• This practice has been **illegal** in India since **1961,** but it still persists in some parts of the country.
 
• The appointment of a** Dowry Prohibition Officer** is expected to help in curbing the practice of dowry and enforcing the law against it.
 
• The **Right to Information Act, 2005**, gives citizens of India the right to access information held by public authorities.
 
• The appointment of a Dowry Prohibition Officer equivalent to a **Right to Information Officer** means that the Dowry Prohibition Officer will have similar powers to obtain information and take action against those who violate the law.
 
• The **Law Commission** is a **statutory body** in India that advises the government on legal reform.
 
• The **Supreme Court's decision** to allow the Law Commission to consider the appointment of a Dowry Prohibition Officer shows the court's commitment to addressing the issue of dowry in India.
